45:t_1:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「How about you guys?! I never thought we'd meet again like this!」

45:t_1:6.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Yeah, really. We haven't even found $$ジャミル$$ and the others yet.」

45:t_1:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Huh?! $$ジャミル$$ and $$ウィッツ$$ aren't with you?」

45:t_1:9.en:
$$パーラ$$
「After the war with $$インサラウム$$, we went back to our Earth and immediately got caught in a $$時空震動$$.」

45:t_1:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「When we came to, $$ティファ$$, $$パーラ$$ and I were here in the '$$残されの海$$'.」

45:t_1:12.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's what they call all the sea around here. I don't know why they named it that, though.」

45:t_1:13.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「You can ask the Fleet Commander about that.」

45:t_1:14.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hey, you guys! Thanks for helping us out back there.」

45:t_1:15.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$ガロード$$... Who are these people?」

45:t_1:16.en:
$$ガロード$$
「They're from the $$ガルガンティア$$ fleet. They're the people I work for, like I told you.」

45:t_1:17.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「I'm $$ベローズ$$. I do salvage work.」

45:t_1:18.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Name's $$ピニオン$$. I'm a repairman.」

45:t_1:19.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Now, $$ガロード$$... I get why you're excited to see old friends, but I need you to finish the job first.」

45:t_1:20.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I know, I know, $$ベローズ$$.」

45:t_1:22.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「That's right. Some friends of mine found an interesting treasure around here.」

45:t_1:23.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「It's sunk in a tricky spot, so I want $$ガロード$$'s $$ダブルエックス$$ to lend us a hand.」

45:t_1:24.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$ガロード$$, they're making you help hunt for treasure?」

45:t_1:25.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's not all. I guard against pirates, help with fishing, load and unload cargo, repair ships...」

45:t_1:26.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It reminds me of when I went to work for $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$.」

45:t_1:27.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Your $$ダブルエックス$$ is a good machine, after all.」

45:t_1:28.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「So, sorry, gentlemen, but I'll have to wait until we're done working to show you to the fleet.」

45:t_1:29.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You saved us from those pirates. The least I can do is buy you a meal.」

45:t_1:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「Thanks. We'll be in your care for a little while.」

45:t_1:31.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We can help hunt for treasure too, if you want.」

45:t_1:34.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Let's go, $$ガロード$$. That treasure's waiting for us.」

45:t_1:39.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「No, it's nothing. ...I'll let $$ガルガンティア$$ know about you. I'd like to meet whoever's in charge here.」

45:t_1:41.en:
$$アルト$$
(The $$翠の地球$$... A green ocean, huh...)

45:t_1:42.en:
$$甲児$$
(The ocean's a slightly different color, but it's still Earth.)

45:t_1:43.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(Just you wait, $$サイデリアル$$. We'll drive you off this planet. I promise.)

45:t_10:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That voice... Are you the pilot of the blue robot that backed me up?」

45:t_10:6.en:
$n
「Yeah, that's me. ...I'm $F. Nice to meet you.」

45:t_10:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm $$ガロード・ラン$$. Same here.」

45:t_10:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sorry, but I'm a little busy. If you need something, make it quick.」

45:t_10:9.en:
$n
「I want to ask about that weapon you call the $$サテライトキャノン$$.」

45:t_10:11.en:
$n
「When you used that weapon, you told the enemy to retreat. What was that about?」

45:t_10:12.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It meant exactly what I said.」

45:t_10:14.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's not it. ...It's just that the $$サテライトキャノン$$... I'd rather not use it if I can help it.」

45:t_10:15.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Nothing good comes of having a weapon that's too powerful.」

45:t_10:17.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sometimes you can't afford to stick to your ideals... But I'd still rather not use it.」

45:t_10:18.en:
$n
「...I see. Sorry for holding you up.」

45:t_10:19.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's fine. Your backup really helped me out.」

45:t_10:21.en:
$$ガロード$$
「See you. Let's take our time talking later.」

45:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It sounds just like a $$スフィア$$.」

45:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ガロード$$'s words seem to have left quite an impression on you.」

45:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no use hiding it. When $$ガロード$$ fired the $$サテライトキャノン$$, you felt a powerful emotion, $n.」

45:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That shock produced 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s. Naturally, I've added them to the team's stock.」

45:t_10:29.en:
$n
「...Hey, $$ＡＧ$$... Was $$ジェニオン$$ built to steal 《$$ジェミニア#keyword$$》's $$スフィア$$?」

45:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I don't know for certain. But that is what I believe.」

45:t_10:31.en:
$n
「According to that $$ブルー$$ person, there are $$スフィア・リアクター$$s on this $$翠の地球$$...」

45:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I hear Miss $$セツコ・オハラ$$, whom $$ギルター$$ mentioned in today's battle, is a $$リアクター$$ too.」

45:t_10:33.en:
$n
「$$ＡＧ$$... Find out as much as you can about the $$スフィア$$s.」

45:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. But to draw out its power...」

45:t_10:36.en:
$n
「Conflicting human emotions trigger the power of $$ジェニオン$$'s $$スフィア$$, the '$$いがみ合う双子$$'...」

45:t_10:37.en:
$n
「I'll try. I don't know how to do it yet, but...」

45:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe you can master the $$スフィア$$, $n, without being at the mercy of its overwhelming power.」

45:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's give ourselves a boost! Once again, with feeling...!」

45:t_10:41.en:
$n
「Sorry... I just can't bring myself to say that.」

uncertain: 45:t_10:17: Rendered the ideals-versus-necessity remark in context as inability to stick to ideals; Garrod still prefers avoiding the cannon.
